body.name: Bseq
body.space: \(\text{the set of deterministic admissible three-way sample-split sequences}\)
body.def: The sequence \(B_{\bullet}=(B_n)_{n\geq1}\), where each \(B_n\) is an admissible deterministic three-way split used by the total-Gram construction; it may depend on the deterministic threshold sequence but not on realized data.
